**结论**
在我们当前 `demo-sala` 体系里，真正“突破性、有意义”的 prefill 加速不再是调 `topk/window/chunk_size/backend` 这些旋钮。高价值方向只剩三类：

1. **MLP `gate_up + SwiGLU + FP4 quant` fused epilogue**
   - 当前 full chunk 会落地约 `512MB` BF16 `gate_up` 中间态，再读回做 SwiGLU/FP4 quant。
   - 最值得攻的是 SM120 dense-only `gate_up_swiglu_fp4`：直接从 FP4 GEMM accumulator 输出 down-proj 需要的 FP4 activation + scale。
   - 这是当前最像“能穿透 wall time”的方向，风险是 FP4 rounding/scale 数值变化，必须过 hidden/logits/public eval。

2. **Sparse stage2 的 KV/block layout 或 custom exact kernel**
   - 当前长 prefill standard attention 是 decode-style virtual batch：每 token/head-group 一行，`96*64=6144` sparse tokens，`page_size=1`，metadata/indices 很重。
   - page64、BlockSparse split、Triton direct 都试过，离线收益没穿透端到端。
   - 真正有意义的是：单 wrapper/单 kernel 直接消费 block-level topk + partial causal block，避免 token-page 展开，同时保持完全等价。

3. **Stage1 `score -> pool -> topk` exact fusion**
   - 不能再做 topk 缩限、k1-only、候选裁剪，这些会破坏 sparse attention 语义。
   - 有价值的是 C++/CUDA 里完整复现当前 InfLLMv2 stage1 + pooling + topk，直接产出 topk blocks，减少大 score tensor 和中间调度。
   - 工程量高，必须 bitwise/topk 对拍。

**旁路但很值得做**
EAGLE 的 `TARGET_VERIFY` 是 prefill-like 路径，不是普通 decode。`TARGET_VERIFY replay de-plan`、D5/D7 形状特化、verify metadata/buffer 预建，语义风险低，可能带来稳定 e2e 收益。它不属于纯长 prompt prefill，但对比赛总耗时有价值。

**不要再投入**
`chunked-prefill-size=16384`、topk 降低、TrtLLM stage2/prefill swap、FlashInfer backend 旋钮、page64 双 wrapper、Triton direct stage2、MLP cuDNN、dense-as-MoE、先把 gate/up 量成 FP4 再 SwiGLU、`--fuse-topk`，这些仓库里基本都已经有反例或收益不足。

**验证口径**
最小可信闭环：

```bash
bash eval/start_eagle.sh
BENCH_API=http://127.0.0.1:30000 python3 bench/kernels/prefill/prefill_bench_smax64.py --trials 3 --concurrency 64
bash bench/quick_validate.sh http://127.0.0.1:30000 <tag> outputs/<tag>
bash bench/mini_bench.sh http://127.0.0.1:30000 12 36 96
python3 eval/run_public_eval_full.py --api-base http://127.0.0.1:30000 --model-path /user_4813494d/models/openbmb/MiniCPM-SALA-gptq46-calib90-90k-NVFP4-det
```

同时对 kernel/fusion 改动比对 aux hidden `[1,10,22]`、final hidden、top logits、accept length，不能只看 tok/s。

外部方向参考：MInference 和 FlexPrefill 都说明动态 sparse prefill 是有效研究线，但它们改变注意力/稀疏选择语义，在我们这里只能作为高风险研究分支；UniPrefill 的 token/block 动态稀疏对 hybrid 架构更贴近，但也必须重新做 accuracy 闭环。FlashInfer docs 也确认 decode/prefill wrapper 的 plan 辅助结构可复用，这是我们 plan-cache/de-plan 方向的依据。

Sources: [MInference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02490), [FlexPrefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20766), [UniPrefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06221), [FlashInfer attention docs](https://docs.flashinfer.ai/api/attention.html), [FlashInfer Cascade Inference](https://flashinfer.ai/2024/02/02/cascade-inference.html).

对，这次应当把“refill/prefill”降级成一个子方向，而不是研究边界。我已用 4 个 subagent 分别查了系统调度、spec decoding、长上下文/KV、kernel/FP4，并结合当前仓库形态综合了一版更宽的路线图。本轮没有改文件。

**核心判断**
我们体系下最有突破价值的方向排序：

1. **Spec / verify / scheduler**
   当前已经有 EAGLE3，所以重点不是换成 Medusa/Hydra，而是让 draft、target verify、rollback、mixed batch 调度更便宜。外部依据：EAGLE / EAGLE-2 / EAGLE-3、SpecInfer、SGLang Speculative Decoding V2。  
   优先实验：`SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=True`、EAGLE3 `(steps,draft_tokens)` sweep、accept-depth 分桶、TARGET_VERIFY 成本拆分。

2. **FP4 kernel 与 MLP/GLA 融合**
   这是比继续抠 prefill 更像“真收益”的方向。当前热点里 MLP/GLA/GEMM 比注意力更硬，外部趋势也指向 FP4/NVFP4、FlashInfer、CUTLASS Blackwell、Marlin/QServe。  
   优先实验：FP4 backend sweep、Marlin threshold 重新按真实 EAGLE mixed batch 调、`gate_up -> silu/mul -> NVFP4 quant -> down` epilogue fusion、RMSNorm+quant fusion。

3. **Decode/verify 阶段的 sparse-KV/page selection**
   不要泛泛做 H2O/SnapKV 这种 KV eviction；SALA 已经是 sparse+GLA，风险很高。更可行的是 Quest-style query-aware page selection，先做 sensitivity map，再考虑 sparse attention 层的保守 page budget。  
   优先实验：full cache vs sink+window vs layer budget vs query-aware pages，必须 no-spec 和 EAGLE3 都测。

4. **Serving/scheduling/cache locality**
   vLLM PagedAttention、SGLang RadixAttention、Sarathi、DistServe、Mooncake、LMCache、NVIDIA Dynamo 都说明：真正系统收益来自 KV reuse、chunked scheduling、P/D disaggregation、KV transfer。  
   对我们：如果平台是单机单卡，P/D disaggregation 优先级低；如果有多 GPU 或重复长前缀，Radix/HiCache/LMCache 可能是大收益。

5. **Draft 模型训练本身**
   当前 EAGLE draft 可能比 runtime trick 更值得押。应该按长上下文、公开集坏例、混合中英/code、TARGET_VERIFY 路径重训或微调 draft，而不是只看普通 LM loss。  
   指标用 `accepted_tokens / (draft_ms + verify_ms)`，不是 draft accuracy。

**我会优先排的实验队列**
1. 加 spec tracing：`accept_depth`、`draft_ms`、`verify_ms`、`rollback_count`、`context_len`、`TARGET_VERIFY`、batch composition。
2. 跑 EAGLE3 static sweep + SpecV2 smoke，先不改模型。
3. 跑 FP4 backend / Marlin threshold production sweep，按真实 `bench/mini_bench.sh` 和 public eval 验。
4. 做 MLP activation+quant fusion microbench，成功后接入 env flag。
5. 做 sparse-KV sensitivity map，再决定 Quest-lite 是否值得进 kernel。
6. 如果 workload 有重复 prefix，再测 Radix/HiCache/LMCache；否则先不投。

**先不要押的方向**
- 直接换 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 全栈：和 `minicpm_flashinfer`、dense-as-sparse、EAGLE3 定制冲突太大。
- 泛化 KV eviction：容易伤长上下文 accuracy 和 EAGLE acceptance。
- NSA/MInference/XAttention 这类长上下文算法替换：适合作研究分支，不适合马上进提交包。
- 只看 tok/s：必须连 `ori_accuracy`、no-spec/spec 一致性、坏例 index 一起看。

主要外部依据：  
[vLLM/PagedAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180), [SGLang/RadixAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07104), [Sarathi-Serve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.02310), [DistServe](https://www.usenix.org/system/files/osdi24-zhong-yinmin.pdf), [Mooncake](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00079), [EAGLE-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.01840), [SGLang speculative docs](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/advanced_features/speculative_decoding), [Quest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10774), [FlashInfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01005), [FlashAttention-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08608), [CUTLASS Blackwell FP4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/cpp/blackwell_functionality.html), [QServe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04532), [Marlin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11743).

> AGENT

已按你的限定重做：**只讨论主测 prefill，不讨论 spec/decode**。4 个 subagent 已并行调查并关闭；本轮只读文件和外部资料，没有改代码。

**结论**
主测 prefill 的突破点不在继续泛泛找 sparse-attention trick，而在三个地方：

1. **MLP gated FP4 epilogue**：最高优先级。当前 `gate_up GEMM -> BF16 gate_up -> SwiGLU+FP4 quant -> down GEMM` 会写回/再读约 512MB/chunk 的中间态。应做 SM120 dense-only `gate_up_swiglu_fp4`，在 GEMM accumulator 内直接算 `silu(gate)*up` 并输出 FP4 activation + scale。相关路径：[minicpm.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm.py:785)，设计记录：[docs/prefill/current.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/docs/prefill/current.md:432)。

2. **Stage2 sparse attention 单路径 kernel/layout**：当前 FlashInfer wrapper 参数基本试完了，page64/BlockSparse 双 wrapper 离线有收益但线上打平。下一步必须是单 wrapper/单 kernel，直接吃 `topk_idx`，避免 token-page expansion 和二次 metadata。相关路径：[minicpm_backend.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_backend.py:1464)，[minicpm_sparse_stage2.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_sparse_stage2.py:64)。

3. **精确 fused stage1 score→pool→topk**：只有在完整保留 K1/K2、causal/full-layout pooler 语义、topk 完全一致时才值得做。stage1 宏观 profile 看起来大，但 nsys 显示真正 GPU 热点更偏 NVFP4 GEMM + FlashInfer sparse stage2，所以它排第三。相关路径：[minicpm_sparse_utils.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_sparse_utils.py:631)。

**主测口径**
当前正式 prefill 形态来自 [prepare_env.sh](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/prepare_env.sh:501)：

```bash
--attention-backend minicpm_flashinfer
--chunked-prefill-size 8192
--dense-as-sparse
--quantization modelopt_fp4
--max-running-requests 36
--mem-fraction-static 0.75
```

主测要分两个口径看：

- 旧纯 prefill bench：[prefill_bench_smax64.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/kernels/prefill/prefill_bench_smax64.py:1)，64 条 `bench/data/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl`，`max_tokens=1`，并发 64。注意它还会 `/flush_cache`，和新记录口径有冲突。
- 当前 `bench/mini_bench.sh` 已改成 `bench/data_full`，默认 `S1=0 S8=36 Smax=96`，Smax 最大 prompt 到 524287/524288 tokens。这个比 line39 15 chunks 压力大得多，必须纳入主测判断。[mini_bench.sh](/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/mini_bench.sh:19)

line39 仍是快速单点：`bench/data/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl` 第 39 行，`index=39`，`prompt_tokens=124070`，约 15 个 8192 chunks。

**当前真实结构**
这不是普通 dense prefill。`--dense-as-sparse` 让 standard attention 层 `dense_len=0`，所有长 prefill 走 sparse 路径：[minicpm_backend.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_backend.py:417)。

实际数据流是：

```text
chunked extend
-> 每层 QKV/GLA/MLP FP4 GEMM
-> standard sparse layer: K/V 写 cache
-> compress K1/K2
-> InfLLM stage1 score/pool/topk
-> topk_idx -> FlashInfer indices
-> FlashInfer decode-style sparse stage2
```

关键点：sparse prefill 被 row 化成 token/head-group 维度，FlashInfer 看到的是 `q_len=1` 的 decode-style rows，不是常规 dense prefill。

**外部调查适配**
外部 prefill-only 方向里，可借鉴但不能直接套：

- TensorRT-LLM chunked context 和 Sarathi-Serve 支持当前 `8192` chunk 思路，但本地 `16384` 已测更慢。
- FlashInfer 方向最贴合，但要做的是 metadata/layout/kernel，不是再调 wrapper 参数。
- MInference / FlexPrefill / XAttention 是 full-attention 模型的 sparse-prefill 思路；SALA 已有 sparse+GLA，直接再裁剪 topk 风险高。
- UniPrefill 很值得跟踪，因为它明确针对 hybrid 架构，正好贴 SALA，但太新，不能当短期依赖。
- Tiled Flash Linear Attention / FlashQLA 对 GLA prefill 有启发，但只能迁移 kernel 思想，不能换语义。
- CUTLASS/FlashInfer/NVFP4/FP4 方向最贴近当前硬件和热点，尤其 MLP epilogue。

外部来源：  
[FlashInfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01005), [FlashAttention-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08608), [MInference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02490), [XAttention](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/eai/publication/xattention/), [Native Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.11089), [UniPrefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06221), [CUTLASS Blackwell FP4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/cpp/blackwell_functionality.html), [FlashInfer FP4 GEMM](https://docs.flashinfer.ai/generated/flashinfer.gemm.mm_fp4.html)。

**建议下一步**
先做一个 prefill-only 实验矩阵：

1. `line39 max_tokens=1` no-flush，记录 chunk profile。
2. `prefill_bench_smax64.py` 64 条，确认旧纯 prefill。

5. 优先开工 MLP gated FP4 epilogue microbench；其次 stage2 single-kernel/layout；第三 stage1 exact fusion。

不要再投：topk 缩限、`chunked-prefill-size=16384`、TrtLLM stage2、page64 双 wrapper、simple Triton stage2、dense-as-MoE MLP、FP4-before-SwiGLU。

**继续调查结论**

我继续按 **主测 prefill-only** 查了三条线：主测 workload/长度校验、本地 roofline、外部 prefill 研究。3 个 subagent 都已完成并关闭；没有改文件，也没有跑长耗时 benchmark。

**1. 主测口径要先修正**

主测不是单条 line39 prefill microbench，而是官方 wrapper 的 serving duration。入口在 [toolkit/bench_serving.sh](/user_4813494d/openbmb/toolkit/bench_serving.sh:47)，会把每行转成 custom conversation，再由 [bench_serving.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/bench_serving.py:1303) 重新 tokenize；`bench/data_full` 里的 `prompt_tokens` 只是参考值，不直接决定请求长度。

`bench/data_full` 形态明显比旧 `bench/data` 更重：

- S1: 12 条，avg prompt `178.9K`，max `524287`，>=500K 有 2 条
- S8: 36 条，avg prompt `177.3K`，max `524288`，>=500K 有 6 条
- Smax: 96 条，avg prompt `171.8K`，max `524288`，>=500K 有 16 条

所以主测 prefill 的核心不再是“128K 左右 15-16 chunks 怎么快一点”，而是 **大量 128K-524K 请求在官方 serving wrapper 下怎么稳定完成**。`--chunked-prefill-size 8192` 来自 [prepare_env.sh](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/prepare_env.sh:501)，Smax 全集大约是 `2050` 个 8K chunks 的量级。

**2. 发现一个 P0 风险：524K 长度可能先被拒绝**

模型 config 是 `max_position_embeddings=524288`，但 server 侧并不是允许输入正好到 524288。Worker 里实际是：

`max_req_len = min(context_len - 1, token_pool_size - 1)`，然后 `max_req_input_len = max_req_len - 5`，见 [tp_worker.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/managers/tp_worker.py:280)。

同时 `--allow-auto-truncate` 默认是 false，见 [server_args.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/server_args.py:590)。长度超限会报错，不会自动截断。

本地 tokenizer 重算后，`prompt + output >= 524288` 的请求数是：S1 `2`、S8 `5`、Smax `13`。这意味着先别急着优化 kernel，必须先做一个 **acceptance probe**：确认这些 524K 请求在正式 server 参数下到底是完整进入 prefill、被拒绝、还是被 wrapper 记成失败耗时。否则速度研究可能在错误 workload 上。

**3. 524K 下瓶颈排序变了**

按现有 profile bucket 外推，128K 和 524K 的结构不一样：

- 128K / 16 chunks：MLP FP4 ~2.1s，GLA ~1.5s，sparse stage2 ~1.3s，stage1 ~0.7s
- 524K / 64 chunks：MLP FP4 ~8.5s，GLA ~6.1s，sparse stage2 ~5.4s，stage1 可能到 ~10.8s

关键变化是 **sparse stage1 随历史长度增长**。旧 nsys 里 stage1 看起来没那么大，但那是 128K 左右视角；到 524K，score/pool/topk 这条线可能变成最大单项之一。

**4. 现在最有意义的 prefill 攻坚顺序**

P0：长度/主测真实性验证。先证明 `data_full` 524K 样本不会被长度校验吞掉；`bench/data_full` 还是 untracked，本身也要确认是否就是当前主测口径。

P0：MLP fused epilogue。当前 [minicpm.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm.py:785) 的 MLP 路径会产生 BF16 gate/up 中间结果，再做 SwiGLU + FP4 quant。全 chunk 下每层这个中间量很大，最有价值的是做 `gate_up -> swiglu -> fp4 quant` 融合，目标是每 chunk 省 `15-30ms`，524K 上可能是秒级收益。

P0：stage1 精确融合。不是近似 topk，而是 exact `score -> pool -> topk`，减少中间 score 物化和多 kernel/metadata 开销。这个方向在 128K 不一定显著，但 524K 值得重新排第一梯队。

P0/P1：sparse stage2 精确 kernel/FlashInfer variant。当前 sparse attention setup 在 [minicpm_backend.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_backend.py:1465)。优先试低寄存器/更贴 SALA topk layout 的精确路径；必须保证同样 topk index、同样输出容差。

P1：chunk size 重新扫。`16384` 在旧 line39 上已经失败，但 524K 主测下 stage1/chunk 数量关系变了，仍值得 A/B/A 扫 `4096/8192/12288/16384`。前提是同一批 524K 请求、同样 correctness/失败率统计。

P2：GLA 外部 kernel。FlashQLA/TFLA 只值得先做 recurrence/state 语义审计；如果和 SALA GLA 不完全同构，不要直接接。

**5. 外部研究的真实落点**

外部资料里最可转化的是两类：

- chunked context / scheduling：NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM chunked context 文档支持我们继续从 chunk 调度和 long-prefill batching 角度看问题。
- exact kernel/FP4：FlashInfer、CUTLASS Blackwell FP4、NVFP4 资料支持继续压 MLP 和 sparse stage2。

MInference、XAttention、FlexPrefill、SeerAttention、UniPrefill 这些更像“block selection/稀疏策略参考”，不能直接放进提交路径。它们如果改变证据选择，必须先做离线 topk overlap、hidden/logit drift、长上下文 accuracy，再谈速度。

**下一步最该做**

先做 3 个实验，不改大代码：

1. 对 `bench/data_full` 全量做 server acceptance probe，记录超限/失败/成功请求 index。
2. 用正式参数 profile 一个 ~128K 样本和一个 ~524K 样本，比较 `mlp_*`、`stage1_score_prefill_ms`、`extend_sparse_fa_ms`。
3. 单独跑 524K stage1 seqlen sweep，确认 stage1 是否真的超过 MLP。

这轮调查后的判断是：突破点仍在 prefill，但不是泛泛“prefill 加速”。主战场已经变成 **524K 长输入下的长度准入、stage1 长度扩展、MLP 中间量消除、stage2 精确稀疏内核**。

The production shape is many query rows with top-k blocks per row. Existing page64, two-wrapper, blocksplit+merge, and simple Triton direct paths did not produce stable e2e wins.\n+\n+Research target:\n+\n+- Either make FlashInfer select a better low-register/specialized variant for this exact shape, or build a single exact block-sparse kernel/layout that consumes `topk_idx` directly.\n+- Avoid dual-wrapper and merge overhead.\n+- Preserve exact causal partial-block behavior.\n+\n+Proof bar:\n+\n+- Same selected KV blocks and same output tolerance.\n+- Stage2 bucket decreases under profile.\n+- End-to-end wall improvement survives A/B/A runs.\n+\n+## P1: Chunk Size Re-Sweep Under Main Workload\n+\n+`chunked-prefill-size=16384` was slower on the old line-39-style benchmark. Because `bench/data_full` includes 500K-scale rows, re-sweep only after accepted-request behavior is clear.\n+\n+Candidate sweep:\n+\n+```text\n+4096, 8192, 12288, 16384\n+```\n+\n+Required measurements:\n+\n+- Accepted row count unchanged except expected protocol filtering.\n+- Peak VRAM and OOM/retract behavior.\n+- MLP/stage1/stage2 bucket changes.\n+- S1/S8/Smax duration.\n+\n+## P2: GLA Kernel Research\n+\n+GLA already has several fused kernels in the current path, and simple API/chunk-size swaps have failed. Remaining gains require exact recurrence-aware kernel redesign.\n+\n+External ideas like FlashQLA or tiled flash linear attention are useful only after proving recurrence/state equivalence with SALA's Lightning/GLA path.\n+\n+## External Research Triage\n+\n+Useful as implementation references:\n+\n+- TensorRT-LLM chunked context / chunked prefill: scheduling and chunk-size tradeoffs.\n+- FlashInfer: attention serving primitives and FP4 support.\n+- CUTLASS Blackwell FP4 / NVFP4 materials: MLP epilogue and FP4 layout direction.\n+\n+Useful only as offline sparse-selection research:\n+\n+- MInference\n+- XAttention\n+- FlexPrefill\n+- SeerAttention\n+- UniPrefill\n+\n+These methods may change which evidence blocks are attended. They must pass block-selection overlap, hidden/logit drift, and long-context accuracy before any speed result matters.\n+\n+Mostly out of scope for the fixed checkpoint:\n+\n+- Native Sparse Attention as an architecture/training direction.\n+- Dense FA3/FA4 swap as the main sparse-prefill solution.\n+\n+## Immediate Experiment Queue\n+\n+1. Official-wrapper run on `bench/data_full`, recording accepted/skipped counts and duration.\n+2. Profile accepted ~128K and ~500K rows with current defaults.\n+3. Stage1 seqlen sweep up to 524288.\n+4. MLP epilogue microbench design for SM120 gated blockscale output.\n+5. Stage2 exact variant/low-register FlashInfer probe.\n+6. Chunk-size A/B/A only after steps 1-3.\n+\n+## Source Links\n+\n+- TensorRT-LLM chunked context: https://nvidia.github.io/TensorRT-LLM/features/paged-attention-ifb-scheduler.html#chunked-context-a-k-a-chunked-prefill\n+- FlashInfer paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01005\n+- FlashInfer FP4 GEMM docs: https://docs.flashinfer.ai/generated/flashinfer.gemm.mm_fp4.html\n+- FlashAttention-3: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08608\n+- MInference: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.02490\n+- FlexPrefill: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20766\n+- XAttention: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.16428\n+- SeerAttention: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13276\n+- UniPrefill: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06221\n+- Native Sparse Attention: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.11089\n+\n*** Add File: prefill/experiment-log.md\n+# Prefill Experiment Log\n+\n+Append new experiments below this template. 完成这一轮本地 prefill-only 实验。已停掉 server，GPU 显存回到 `0MiB`。

新增/更新：

- [prefill/single_longest_prefill.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/single_longest_prefill.py:1): 单条最长 accepted prompt 的快速 prefill benchmark。
- [prefill/experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md:1): 写入本轮实验结果。
- [prefill/README.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/README.md:1): 加了 fast local benchmark 入口。

**固定目标样本**

`bench/data_full/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl` line 91 / index 91：

- server prompt tokens: `524183`
- `max_tokens=1`
- response: `<think>`
- 更长的 15 个候选都按预期被长度规则拒绝，不管它们。

**关键结果**

同样 `mem_fraction_static=0.75 / max_running_requests=36`：

| chunk size | latencies |
|---:|---:|
| `4096` | `40.87s`, `34.87s`, `34.84s` |
| `8192` | `35.43s`, `34.82s` |
| `12288` | `38.08s`, `35.67s` |
| `16384` | `38.19s`, `36.31s` |

结论：`8192` 仍是最稳的默认值。`4096` 稳态几乎打平，值得后续 profile，但不是明确胜出。`12288/16384` 不值得继续优先投。

额外负结果：`16384 + mem_fraction=0.85 + max_running_requests=160` 会在 MLP `gate_up_proj` 处 OOM；换成 `0.75/36` 后能跑通，但仍慢。

Profile 观察：`8192` 下 line91 后段 chunk 的 sparse stage1 明显爬升，late chunk `stage1_score_prefill_ms` 到约 `260-317ms/chunk`，已经是下一阶段最值得打的点。

已完成本地离线 profile 和校验，结果写进了：

- [stage1_offline_profile.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_offline_profile.py)
- [stage1-profile.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1-profile.md)
- [experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md)
- [roadmap.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/roadmap.md)

核心结论：line91 tail 形状下，单层 `stage1` 约 `40.6ms`，8 个 sparse layer 合计约 `325ms/chunk`，和服务端观察到的 late chunk `stage1_score_prefill_ms ~= 260-317ms/chunk` 对上了。`stage1 -> pool -> topk` 整段约 `43.1ms/layer`，8 层约 `345ms/chunk`。

底层 profiler 也确认瓶颈在 stage1 kernel 本身：

```text
flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel    39.765ms   92.29%
aten::topk                          1.212ms    2.81%
max_pooling_1d_varlen_kernel        1.047ms    2.43%
aten::fill_                         0.772ms    1.79%
```

离线校验结果：

- 手工 `stage1 -> max_pool -> topk` 和生产 `compressed_attention` 的 topk 在 sweep 形状上完全一致。
- 当前 no-extra-zero wrapper 与 upstream wrapper 输出 `max_abs=0.0`。
- no-extra-zero 已经省下约 `0.6-0.8ms/layer`；剩下的 `fill_` 只值约 `6ms/chunk`，不是主战场。

下一步最有意义的优化方向不是单独改 topk/pool，而是做**精确 stage1 fusion**：避免物化 `[2, q_len, rounded_k1_len]` 的巨大 score tensor，同时保持 K1+K2 语义和 topk block IDs 完全一致。tail 这个 score tensor 约 1GiB，是现在最值得打的点。

产物日志在：

- `/tmp/prefill_stage1_offline_profile.jsonl`
- `/tmp/prefill_stage1_offline_profile_compare.jsonl`
- `/tmp/prefill_stage1_tail_torch_profiler.txt`
- `/tmp/prefill_stage1_tail_trace.json`

The existing no-extra-zero wrapper already removes a second zero pass, but the C++ binding still appears to allocate the score tensor with a fill.\n+\n+## Comparison Checks\n+\n+Actual `compressed_attention` topk equality:\n+\n+- Manual `stage1 -> max_pool -> topk` matched `compressed_attention` for all sweeped production shapes.\n+- This validates the offline profile as an exact topk-selection proxy.\n+\n+Wrapper comparison:\n+\n+| seq_len | current no-extra-zero | upstream wrapper | max abs diff |\n+|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n+| `393216` | `30.779ms` | `31.389ms` | `0.0` |\n+| `524183` | `40.643ms` | `41.473ms` | `0.0` |\n+\n+The current `_infllmv2_attn_stage1_no_extra_zero` path is exact and saves about `0.6-0.8ms/layer` at late lengths.\n+\n+Padded maxlen comparison:\n+\n+| seq_len | actual maxlen | padded maxlen |\n+|---:|---:|---:|\n+| `393216` | `30.779ms` | `31.753ms` |\n+| `524183` | `40.643ms` | `41.709ms` |\n+\n+Tightening `max_seqlen_k` is already enabled and correct, but it is not a large remaining lever at late lengths.\n+\n+## Optimization Read\n+\n+P0 remains an exact stage1 fusion, but it must be a real stage1 redesign, not just a pool/topk rewrite.\n+\n+The useful target is:\n+\n+```text\n+Q/K stage1 scoring -> block pooling -> topk\n+```\n+\n+without materializing the full bf16 score tensor:\n+\n+```text\n+[2, q_len, rounded_k1_len]\n+```\n+\n+For the line91 tail this score tensor is about `1.0 GiB`. An exact fused kernel can stream scores into block maxima or topk state, while preserving K1+K2 semantics and the same block IDs.\n+\n+Lower-priority levers:\n+\n+- Replace the remaining stage1 output `fill_` with empty allocation if the C++ extension source can be rebuilt and the kernel provably writes every valid output. Estimated tail gain is about `0.77ms/layer`, or about `6ms/chunk`.\n+- A custom topk can only target about `1.4ms/layer` at the tail, and less after accounting for sort/copy. This is not enough to be the next main target.\n+- Pool-only tuning is capped near `1.0ms/layer` at the tail.\n+- Chunk-size tuning cannot remove the linear `q_len * k1_len` work; smaller chunks mostly redistribute the same stage1 work across more chunks.\n+\n+Proof bar for any replacement:\n+\n+- Bitwise-identical topk indices against `prefill/stage1_offline_profile.py` on the sweep above.\n+- Then run the single line91 request and compare long-context response sanity.\n+- Only after that run public accuracy or a wider official-wrapper speed pass.\n*** End Patch\n"
}

完成了这轮 `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel` 深入 profile、bitwise 优化原型、离线校验和线上单最长请求 A/B。

核心结果：

- line91 tail 形状：`seq_len=524183`, `q_len=8087`, `score=[2,8087,32768]`
- `flash_fwd_splitkv_stage1_kernel` 约 `39.7ms/layer`，8 个 sparse layer 约 `325ms/chunk`
- Nsight Systems 确认 stage1 kernel 占 GPU kernel 时间约 `97.8%`
- NCU 在本机 `RTX 6000D` 上不可用，报 unsupported SKU
- raw empty score allocation 是错误的，会改变 topk
- `EMPTY_P=2` 方案：empty allocation 后只 zero future/padding columns，direct-pool 门控下离线 topk bitwise 通过

线上单最长请求 A/B：

```text
baseline steady avg: 34.822s
empty-P2 steady avg: 34.637s
gain: 0.185s, about 0.53%
```

> AGENT

我重新聚焦到高收益选型，结论很明确：

`stage1` 的 `10.68s` 主要不是 P 写出，也不是 pool/topk，而是第二遍 K1 扫描。

关键上限数据：

```text
line91 全 chunks / 8 sparse layers:
full stage1:        10.684s
no P write:         10.425s
first pass only:     2.166s
pool/topk:           0.744s
```

所以收益排序应该是：

1. **最高收益：跳过或大幅减少第二遍 K1 scan**
   目标是 K2/低分辨率候选选择 + selective K1 refinement。上限约 `9.26s`，但这是 accuracy-risking 路线，必须先测真实 hidden state 的候选 recall。

2. **中等收益：exact stage1 -> blockmax/topk fusion**
   保持 exact semantics，但仍要扫 K1。line91 上限约 `1.0s`，安全但不是突破。

3. **低收益：P write / empty-P / topk / pool 微调**
   empty-P2 已验证只有 `0.53%` 线上收益；不应继续作为主线。

我做了这些更新：

- 新增 [stage1_no_p_upper_bound.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_no_p_upper_bound.py)，用于测 no-P 和 first-pass-only 上限。
- 在本地 InfLLM-v2 加了默认关闭的 `INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_FIRST_PASS_ONLY=1` profiling mode。
- 在 [minicpm_backend.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_backend.py) 加了默认关闭的真实张量 capture hook：
  - `SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_CAPTURE_DIR`
  - `SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_CAPTURE_MAX`
  - `SGLANG_MINICPM_STAGE1_CAPTURE_MIN_K1`
- 更新了 [stage1-profile.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1-profile.md)、[roadmap.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/roadmap.md)、[experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md)。

验证：

- 本地 InfLLM-v2 rebuild 完成，md5: `dc92d2e2813189baa628c19fa8f08f99`
- 默认路径 recheck：`manual_vs_compressed_topk_equal=true`
- `py_compile` 通过
- 当前无 server/build 残留，GPU 空闲

下一步应该跑 line91 capture，然后做 K2 候选 recall 分析。只有 recall 足够高，这条 5s+ 路线才值得进 kernel/refinement 实现。

torch\n+\n+\n+DEFAULT_CAPTURE_GLOB = \"/tmp/prefill_stage1_capture/*.pt\"\n+\n+\n+@dataclass\n+class SweepStats:\n+    hit_global: int = 0\n+    total_global: int = 0\n+    hit_all: int = 0\n+    total_all: int = 0\n+    full_rows_global: int = 0\n+    total_rows: int = 0\n+    candidate_sum: int = 0\n+    candidate_max: int = 0\n+\n+    def update(\n+        self,\n+        *,\n+        hit_global: torch.Tensor,\n+        total_global: torch.Tensor,\n+        hit_all: torch.Tensor,\n+        total_all: torch.Tensor,\n+        candidate_count: torch.Tensor,\n+    ) -> None:\n+        self.hit_global += int(hit_global.sum().item())\n+        self.total_global += int(total_global.sum().item())\n+        self.hit_all += int(hit_all.sum().item())\n+        self.total_all += int(total_all.sum().item())\n+        valid_rows = total_global > 0\n+        self.full_rows_global += int(((hit_global == total_global) & valid_rows).sum().item())\n+        self.total_rows += int(valid_rows.sum().item())\n+        self.candidate_sum += int(candidate_count.sum().item())\n+        self.candidate_max = max(self.candidate_max, int(candidate_count.max().item()))\n+\n+    def as_dict(self, *, topk: int, radius: int, block_count: int) -> dict[str, float | int]:\n+        global_recall = self.hit_global / self.total_global if self.total_global else 1.0\n+        all_recall = self.hit_all / self.total_all if self.total_all else 1.0\n+        full_row_rate = self.full_rows_global / self.total_rows if self.total_rows else 1.0\n+        avg_candidates = self.candidate_sum / self.total_rows if self.total_rows else 0.0\n+        return {\n+            \"k2_topk\": topk,\n+            \"radius\": radius,\n+            \"global_recall\": global_recall,\n+            \"all_recall\": all_recall,\n+            \"global_full_row_rate\": full_row_rate,\n+            \"avg_candidate_blocks\": avg_candidates,\n+            \"max_candidate_blocks\": self.candidate_max,\n+            \"candidate_frac\": avg_candidates / block_count if block_count else 0.0,\n+            \"global_hits\": self.hit_global,\n+            \"global_total\": self.total_global,\n+        }\n+\n+\n+def parse_int_list(value: str) -> list[int]:\n+    return [int(part) for part in value.replace(\" \", \"\").split(\",\") if part]\n+\n+\n+def resolve_capture(pattern: str) -> Path:\n+    paths = sorted(glob.glob(pattern))\n+    if not paths:\n+        raise FileNotFoundError(f\"no capture files matched {pattern!r}\")\n+    if len(paths) > 1:\n+        print(f\"[stage1-k2-recall] using first capture: {paths[0]} ({len(paths)} matched)\")\n+    return Path(paths[0])\n+\n+\n+def forced_block_mask(\n+    *,\n+    q_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    block_count: int,\n+    block_size: int,\n+    init_blocks: int,\n+    local_blocks: int,\n+    device: torch.device,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    block_ids = torch.arange(block_count, device=device)\n+    q_blocks = (q_indices.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64) + cache_len) // block_size\n+    init_mask = block_ids.view(1, -1) < init_blocks\n+    local_start = torch.clamp(q_blocks - local_blocks, min=0)\n+    local_end = torch.clamp(q_blocks, max=block_count - 1)\n+    local_mask = (block_ids.view(1, -1) >= local_start.view(-1, 1)) & (\n+        block_ids.view(1, -1) <= local_end.view(-1, 1)\n+    )\n+    return init_mask | local_mask\n+\n+\n+def exact_membership(\n+    exact_topk: torch.Tensor,\n+    forced_mask: torch.Tensor,\n+    *,\n+    block_count: int,\n+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:\n+    exact = exact_topk.to(dtype=torch.int64)\n+    valid = (exact >= 0) & (exact < block_count)\n+    exact_safe = exact.clamp(min=0, max=block_count - 1)\n+\n+    exact_all = torch.zeros(\n+        (*exact.shape[:2], block_count),\n+        dtype=torch.bool,\n+        device=exact.device,\n+    )\n+    exact_all.scatter_(2, exact_safe, valid)\n+\n+    forced = forced_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(exact.shape[0], -1, -1)\n+    exact_global = exact_all & ~forced\n+    return exact_all, exact_global, forced\n+\n+\n+def candidate_mask_from_topk(\n+    k2_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    forced: torch.Tensor,\n+    *,\n+    topk: int,\n+    radius: int,\n+    block_count: int,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    candidate = forced.clone()\n+    base = k2_indices[:, :, :topk].to(dtype=torch.int64)\n+    for delta in range(-radius, radius + 1):\n+        idx = base + delta\n+        valid = (idx >= 0) & (idx < block_count)\n+        candidate.scatter_(2, idx.clamp(min=0, max=block_count - 1), valid)\n+    return candidate\n+\n+\n+def compute_k2_topk(\n+    *,\n+    q: torch.Tensor,\n+    k2: torch.Tensor,\n+    q_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    block_size: int,\n+    actual_k2_len: int,\n+    max_topk: int,\n+    device: torch.device,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    q = q.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16, non_blocking=True)\n+    k2 = k2[:actual_k2_len].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16, non_blocking=True)\n+    q_len, q_heads, head_dim = q.shape\n+    kv_heads = k2.shape[1]\n+    group = q_heads // kv_heads\n+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(head_dim)\n+\n+    qg = q.reshape(q_len, kv_heads, group, head_dim).permute(1, 2, 0, 3).contiguous()\n+    kt = k2.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()\n+    logits = torch.matmul(qg, kt.unsqueeze(1)).mul_(scale).float()\n+\n+    k2_ids = torch.arange(actual_k2_len, device=device)\n+    q_blocks = (q_indices.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64) + cache_len) // block_size\n+    valid = k2_ids.view(1, 1, 1, -1) <= q_blocks.view(1, 1, -1, 1)\n+    logits.masked_fill_(~valid, float(\"-inf\"))\n+\n+    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)\n+    score = probs.sum(dim=1)\n+    return score.topk(min(max_topk, actual_k2_len), dim=-1, sorted=False).indices\n+\n+\n+def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> list[dict[str, float | int]]:\n+    capture_path = resolve_capture(args.capture)\n+    data = torch.load(capture_path, map_location=\"cpu\")\n+\n+    q_cpu = data[\"query_layer\"]\n+    k2_cpu = row_ids = torch.randperm(q_len, generator=gen)[:limit].sort().values\n+\n+    print(\n+        json.dumps(\n+            {\n+                \"capture\": str(capture_path),\n+ \"actual_k2_len\": actual_k2_len,\n+                \"cache_len\": cache_len,\n+                \"forced_init_blocks\": init_blocks,\n+                \"forced_local_blocks_kernel_arg\": local_blocks,\n+            },\n+            sort_keys=True,\n+        )\n+    )\n+\n+    for start in range(0, int(row_ids.numel()), args.chunk_rows):\n+        rows = row_ids[start : start + q_indices=rows,\n+            cache_len=cache_len,\n+            block_count=block_count,\n+            block_size=block_size,\n+            init_blocks=init_blocks,\n+            local_blocks=local_blocks,\n+            device=device,\n+        )\n+        exact_all, exact_global, forced = exact_membership(\n+            exact_chunk,\n+            forced_rows,\n+ init_mask | local_mask\n+\n+\n+def exact_masks(\n+    exact: torch.Tensor,\n+    forced_rows: torch.Tensor,\n+    *,\n+    block_count: int,\n+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:\n+    valid = (exact >= 0) & (exact < block_count)\n+    safe = exact.clamp(min=0, max=block_count - 1)\n+    exact_all = torch.zeros((*exact.shape[:2], block_count), dtype=torch.bool, device=exact.device)\n+    exact_all.scatter_(2, safe, valid)\n+    exact_global = exact_all & ~forced_rows.unsqueeze(0)\n+    return exact_all, exact_global\n+\n+\n+def k1_valid_mask(\n+    *,\n+    q_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    actual_k1_len: int,\n+    kernel_stride: int,\n+    device: torch.device,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    k_ids = torch.arange(actual_k1_len, device=device)\n+    q_pos = q_indices.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64) + cache_len\n+    max_k = q_pos // kernel_stride\n+    return k_ids.view(1, -1) <= max_k.view(-1, 1)\n+\n+\n+def k2_log_denominator(\n+    *,\n+    q_sel: torch.Tensor,\n+    k2_h: torch.Tensor,\n+    q_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    block_size: int,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    heads, rows, dim = q_sel.shape\n+    actual_k2_len = k2_h.shape[0]\n+    logits = torch.matmul(q_sel, k2_h.t()).mul_(1.0 / math.sqrt(dim)).float()\n+    k2_ids = torch.arange(actual_k2_len, device=q_sel.device)\n+    q_blocks = (q_indices.to(device=q_sel.device, dtype=torch.int64) + cache_len) // block_size\n+    valid = k2_ids.view(1, 1, -1) <= q_blocks.view(1, -1, 1)\n+    logits.masked_fill_(~valid, float(\"-inf\"))\n+    return torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1)\n+\n+\n+def pooled_block_scores(\n+    *,\n+    q_sel: torch.Tensor,\n+    k1_h: torch.Tensor,\n+    k2_h: torch.Tensor,\n+    q_indices: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    kernel_stride: int,\n+    block_size: int,\n+    block_count: int,\n+    score_mode: str,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    heads, rows, dim = q_sel.shape\n+    actual_k1_len = k1_h.shape[0]\n+    logits = torch.matmul(q_sel, k1_h.t()).mul_(1.0 / math.sqrt(dim)).float()\n+    valid_k1 = k1_valid_mask(\n+        q_indices=q_indices,\n+        cache_len=cache_len,\n+        actual_k1_len=actual_k1_len,\n+        kernel_stride=kernel_stride,\n+        device=q_sel.device,\n+    )\n+    logits.masked_fill_(~valid_k1.view(1, rows, actual_k1_len), float(\"-inf\"))\n+\n+    if score_mode == \"k2_denom\":\n+        log_denom = k2_log_denominator(\n+            q_sel=q_sel,\n+            k2_h=k2_h,\n+            q_indices=q_indices,\n+            cache_len=cache_len,\n+            block_size=block_size,\n+        )\n+        score = torch.exp(torch.clamp(logits - log_denom.unsqueeze(-1), max=20.0)).sum(dim=0)\n+    elif score_mode == \"k1_softmax\":\n+        score = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).sum(dim=0)\n+    elif score_mode == \"raw_exp\":\n+        score = torch.exp(torch.clamp(logits - logits.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True), max=20.0)).sum(dim=0)\n+    else:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"unknown score_mode={score_mode}\")\n+\n+    score = score.masked_fill(~valid_k1, 0.0)\n+    pooled = F.max_pool1d(\n+        score.unsqueeze(1),\n+        kernel_size=max(1, block_size // kernel_stride + 1),\n+        stride=max(1, block_size // kernel_stride),\n+        padding=1,\n+    ).squeeze(1)\n+    block_score = torch.full((rows, block_count), float(\"-inf\"), device=q_sel.device)\n+    block_score[:, : pooled.shape[1]] = pooled[:, :block_count]\n+    return block_score\n+\n+\n+def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> list[dict[str, object]]:\n+    capture = resolve_capture(args.capture)\n+    data = torch.load(capture, map_location=\"cpu\")\n+    q_cpu = data[\"query_layer\"]\n+    k1_cpu = data[\"compressed_k1\"]\n+    k2_cpu = data[\"compressed_k2\"]\n+    exact_cpu = data[\"exact_topk_idx\"]\n+\n+    cache_len = int(data[\"cache_lens\"][0].item())\n+    kernel_stride = int(data[\"kernel_stride\"])\n+    block_size = int(data[\"block_size\"])\n+    init_blocks = int(data[\"init_blocks\"])\n+    local_blocks = int(data[\"local_blocks\"])\n+    topk = int(data[\"sparse_topk\"])\n+    actual_k1_len = int(data[\"cu_seqlens_k1\"][-1].item())\n+    actual_k2_len = int(data[\"cu_seqlens_k2\"][-1].item())\n+    block_count = max(int(exact_cpu.max().item()) + 1, math.ceil(k1_cpu.shape[0] * kernel_stride / block_size))\n+    q_len = int(q_cpu.shape[0])\n+    device = torch.device(args.device)\n+    head_sets = parse_head_sets(args.head_sets)\n+    stats = {name: Stats() for name in head_sets}\n+\n+    if args.rows == \"all\":\n+        row_ids = torch.arange(q_len, dtype=torch.int64)\n+    else:\n+        limit = min(int(args.rows), q_len)\n+        if args.row_policy == \"tail\":\n+            row_ids = torch.arange(q_len - limit, q_len, dtype=torch.int64)\n+        elif args.row_policy == \"head\":\n+            row_ids = torch.arange(0, limit, dtype=torch.int64)\n+        else:\n+            gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.seed)\n+            row_ids = torch.randperm(q_len, generator=gen)[:limit].sort().values\n+\n+    print(\n+        json.dumps(\n+            {\n+                \"capture\": str(capture),\n+                \"layer_id\": data.get(\"layer_id\"),\n+                \"rows\": int(row_ids.numel()),\n+                \"q_len\": q_len,\n+                \"actual_k1_len\": actual_k1_len,\n+                \"actual_k2_len\": actual_k2_len,\n+                \"block_count\": block_count,\n+                \"score_mode\": args.score_mode,\n+            },\n+            sort_keys=True,\n+        )\n+    )\n+\n+    k1 = k1_cpu[:actual_k1_len].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n+    k2 = k2_cpu[:actual_k2_len].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n+\n+    for start in range(0, int(row_ids.numel()), args.chunk_rows):\n+        rows = row_ids[start : start + args.chunk_rows]\n+        q_chunk = q_cpu[rows].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n+        exact_chunk = exact_cpu[:, rows].to(device=device, dtype=torch.int64)\n+        forced_rows = forced_block_mask(\n+            q_indices=rows,\n+            cache_len=cache_len,\n+            block_count=block_count,\n+            block_size=block_size,\n+            init_blocks=init_blocks,\n+            local_blocks=local_blocks,\n+            device=device,\n+        )\n+        exact_all, exact_global = exact_masks(exact_chunk, forced_rows, block_count=block_count)\n+        total_global = exact_global.sum(dim=2)\n+        total_all = exact_all.sum(dim=2)\n+\n+        q_grouped = q_chunk.reshape(q_chunk.shape[0], 2, 16, q_chunk.shape[-1]).permute(1, 2, 0, 3)\n+        for name, selected_heads in head_sets.items():\n+            candidate = forced_rows.unsqueeze(0).expand(2, -1, -1).clone()\n+            for kv_head in range(2):\n+                q_sel = q_grouped[kv_head, selected_heads].contiguous()\n+                block_score = pooled_block_scores(\n+                    q_sel=q_sel,\n+                    k1_h=k1[:, kv_head, :].contiguous(),\n+                    k2_h=k2[:, kv_head, :].contiguous(),\n+                    q_indices=rows,\n+                    cache_len=cache_len,\n+                    kernel_stride=kernel_stride,\n+                    block_size=block_size,\n+                    block_count=block_count,\n+                    score_mode=args.score_mode,\n+                )\n+                block_score.masked_fill_(forced_rows, float(\"inf\"))\n+                idx = block_score.topk(topk, dim=-1, sorted=False).indices\n+                candidate[kv_head].zero_()\n+                candidate[kv_head].scatter_(1, idx, True)\n+            hit_global = (candidate & exact_global).sum(dim=2)\n+            hit_all = (candidate & exact_all).sum(dim=2)\n+            stats[name].update(\n+                hit_global=hit_global,\n+                total_global=total_global,\n+                hit_all=hit_all,\n+                total_all=total_all,\n+            )\n+\n+        del q_chunk, exact_chunk, exact_all, exact_global\n+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n+\n+    results = [stats[name].as_dict(name=name, selected_heads=head_sets[name]) for name in head_sets]\n+    results.sort(key=lambda rec: (-float(rec[\"global_recall\"]), float(rec[\"head_frac\"])))\n+    for rec in results:\n+        print(json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True))\n+    return results\n+\n+\n+def main() -> None:\n+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--capture\", default=DEFAULT_CAPTURE_GLOB)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--device\", default=\"cuda\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--rows\", default=\"512\", help=\"'all' or a row count\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--row-policy\", choices=[\"tail\", \"head\", \"random\"], default=\"tail\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=0)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--chunk-rows\", type=int, default=64)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--score-mode\", choices=[\"k2_denom\", \"k1_softmax\", \"raw_exp\"], default=\"k2_denom\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--head-sets\", default=\"default\")\n+    args = parser.parse_args()\n+    run(args)\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    main()\n*** End Patch\n"
}

> AGENT

已完成一轮最高收益探索，结论写入了 `prefill/` 文档，并新增两个离线 recall 脚本：

- [stage1_k2_candidate_recall.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_k2_candidate_recall.py)
- [stage1_head_subset_recall.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_head_subset_recall.py)
- 结果记录在 [stage1-profile.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1-profile.md) 和 [experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md)
- 路线更新在 [roadmap.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/roadmap.md)

核心结论：

1. 最高收益候选是 `K2 candidate + selective K1 refinement`，但要 layer-specific：`L0` 先保持 exact，`L9+` 用 K2 selective。
   - K2 `topk=1024,r=8`：跨 8 层 global recall 均值 `99.42%`，但 L0 只有 `96.74%`。
   - 排除 L0 后，min global recall 到 `99.58%`，candidate fraction 约 `43%`。
   - 粗略 stage1 模型：L0 exact + 其他层 selective，尾段 stage1 可能省约 `40%`，这是当前最值得继续打的点。

2. `head-subset` 稳但收益弱：
   - `h14 + candidate_topk=256`：global recall mean `99.69%`，min `99.38%`。
   - 但它仍扫 `87.5%` heads，且也要新 kernel，优先级低于 K2 selective。

3. 现有 `--fuse-topk` 已实测拒绝：
   - line91 prefill chunk 变成约 `6-7s/chunk`，远慢于默认路径，已提前终止。

4. 实现切口也明确了：
   - InfLLM stage1 里已有 `fwdIterator/blockmask` 跳块机制。
   - 但不能直接把 blockmask 套到整个 stage1，因为第一遍 K2 denominator 必须 dense。
   - 下一刀应新增“second K1 pass only”的 candidate mask：K2 pass 不变，第二遍 K1 只扫候选 tile，并保留 exact fallback/check gate。

验证已跑：

```text
python3 -m py_compile prefill/stage1_k2_candidate_recall.py
python3 -m py_compile prefill/stage1_head_subset_recall.py
```

当前没有 sglang server 在跑。

> AGENT

预期收益按当前数据粗算：

```text
line91 full stage1:       10.68s
first K2 pass fixed:       2.17s
second K1 pass部分:        8.52s
```

如果 `L0 exact`，其余 7 个 sparse layers 用 `K2 topk=1024,r=8`，candidate fraction 约 `43%`：

```text
second K1 pass保留比例 = (1 + 7 * 0.43) / 8 = ~50.1%
second K1 pass预计:     8.52s * 0.501 = ~4.27s
new stage1预计:         2.17s + 4.27s = ~6.44s
stage1节省:             ~4.24s
```

所以理论上对 line91 单条最长：

```text
stage1: 10.68s -> ~6.4s，省 ~4.2s
e2e:    34.8s  -> ~30.5s 左右，上限约 12%
```

但这是乐观上限。实际要扣掉：

- K2 candidate/topk 构造开销
- candidate blockmask 写入/传参开销
- K1 selective tile 跳转不一定完全线性
- recall 不是 100%，需要 fallback/check 策略

我会把现实预期定在：

```text
保守:   2.0s - 2.8s line91 e2e
合理:   3.0s - 3.8s

k2=d['compressed_k2']; Q=q.shape[0]\n    rows=torch.arange(Q,dtype=torch.int64)\n    block_count=max(int(d['exact_topk_idx'].max())+1, math.ceil(k2.shape[0]*64/int(d['block_size'])))\n    forced=forced_block_mask(q_indices=rows, cache_len=int(d['cache_lens'][0]), block_count=block_count, block_size=int(d['block_size']), init_blocks=int(d['init_blocks']), local_blocks=int(d['local_blocks']), device=torch.device('cuda'))\n    # process chunks to avoid OOM; collect candidate tile counts\n    tile_counts=[]; block_counts=[]\n    for s in range(0,Q,64):\n        rs=rows[s:s+64]\n        f=forced[s:s+64]\n        idx=compute_k2_topk(q=q[rs], k2=k2, q_indices=rs, forced_rows=f, cache_len=int(d['cache_lens'][0]), block_size=int(d['block_size']), actual_k2_len=int(d['cu_seqlens_k2'][-1]), max_topk=1024, device=torch.device('cuda'))\n        cand=candidate_mask_from_topk(idx, f.unsqueeze(0).expand(2,-1,-1).clone(), topk=1024, radius=8, block_count=block_count)\n        # stage1 tile covers 64 K1-compressed positions = 16 sparse blocks due pool stride 4\n        B=cand.shape[-1]\n        pad=(-B)%16\n        if pad:\n            cand=torch.nn.functional.pad(cand,(0,pad))\n        tiles=cand.reshape(2, cand.shape[1], -1, 16).any(-1)\n        tile_counts.append(tiles.sum(-1).float().cpu())\n        block_counts.append(cand.sum(-1).float().cpu())\n    tile_counts=torch.cat(tile_counts,dim=1)\n    block_counts=torch.cat(block_counts,dim=1)\n    layer=d['layer_id']\n    total_tiles=math.ceil(block_count/16)\n    print(json.dumps({'layer':layer,'block_frac_avg':float(block_counts.mean()/block_count),'tile_frac_avg':float(tile_counts.mean()/total_tiles),'tile_frac_p50':float(tile_counts.flatten().median()/total_tiles),'tile_frac_max':float(tile_counts.max()/total_tiles),'avg_tiles':float(tile_counts.mean()),'total_tiles':total_tiles}, sort_keys=True))\nPY",

dtype=torch.bool, device=device)\n+\n+    for start in range(0, q_len, chunk_rows):\n+        end = min(start + chunk_rows, q_len)\n+        rows = torch.arange(start, end, dtype=torch.int64)\n+ init_blocks=init_blocks,\n+            local_blocks=local_blocks,\n+            device=device,\n+        )\n+        forced_tiles = forced_sparse.reshape(end - start, num_tiles, sparse_blocks_per_tile).any(dim=-1)\n+        tile_mask[:, start:end, :] |= forced_tiles.unsqueeze(0)\n+\n+        k2_indices = k2_topk_for_rows(\n+            q_rows=q_cpu[start:end],\n+            k2=k2_cpu,\n+            row_ids=rows,\n+            forced_sparse=forced_sparse,\n+            cache_len=cache_len,\n+            block_size=block_size,\n+            actual_k2_len=actual_k2_len,\n+            topk=topk,\n+            device=device,\n+        )\n+        base = k2_indices.to(dtype=torch.int64)\n+        for delta in range(-radius, radius + 2):\n+            sparse_idx = base + delta\n+            valid = (sparse_idx >= 0) & (sparse_idx < block_count)\n+            tile_idx = torch.div(sparse_idx.clamp(min=0, max=block_count - 1), sparse_blocks_per_tile, rounding_mode=\"floor\")\n+            tile_mask[:, start:end, :].scatter_(2, tile_idx, valid)\n+\n+    return tile_mask\n+\n+\n+def exact_tile_recall(\n+    *,\n+    exact_topk: torch.Tensor,\n+    tile_mask: torch.Tensor,\n+    cache_len: int,\n+    block_size: int,\n+    init_blocks: int,\n+    local_blocks: int,\n+) -> dict[str, float | int]:\n+    kv_heads, q_len, _ = tile_mask.shape\n+ forced_block_mask(\n+        row_ids=rows,\n+        cache_len=cache_len,\n+        block_count=block_count,\n+        block_size=block_size,\n+        init_blocks=init_blocks,\n+        local_blocks=local_blocks,\n+        device=tile_mask.device,\n+    )\n+    exact = exact_topk.to(device=tile_mask.device, dtype=torch.int64)\n+    valid = (exact >= 0) & (exact < block_count)\n+    safe = exact.clamp(min=0, max=block_count - 1)\n+    forced_at_exact = forced.unsqueeze(0).expand(kv_heads, -1, -1).gather(2, safe)\n+    global_valid = valid & ~forced_at_exact\n+    exact_tiles = torch.div(safe, sparse_blocks_per_tile, rounding_mode=\"floor\")\n+    hit = tile_mask.gather(2, exact_tiles) & global_valid\n+    total_global = int(global_valid.sum().item())\n+    hit_global = int(hit.sum().item())\n+    full_rows = int(((hit.sum(dim=-1) == global_valid.sum(dim=-1)) & (global_valid.sum(dim=-1) > 0)).sum().item())\n+    total_rows = int((global_valid.sum(dim=-1) > 0).sum().item())\n+    return {\n+        \"tile_global_recall\": hit_global / total_global if total_global else 1.0,\n+        \"tile_full_row_rate\": full_rows / total_rows if total_rows else stage1_k1_blockmask: torch.Tensor | None,\n+) -> torch.Tensor:\n+    fn = infllm_v2_C.varlen_fwd_stage1_k1_mask if stage1_k1_blockmask is not None else infllm_v2_C.varlen_fwd_stage1\n+    args = [\n+        q_adj,\n+        k1,\n+        k2,\n+        None,\n+        cu_q_adj,\n+        cu_k1,\n+        cu_k2,\n+        None,\n+        None,\n+        None,\n+        None,\n+        max_seqlen_q_adjusted,\n+        max_seqlen_k1,\n+        0.0,\n+        q_adj.shape[-1] ** -0.5,\n+        False,\n+        causal,\n+        -1,\n+        -1,\n+        0.0,\n+        True,\n+        None,\n+    ]\n+    if stage1_k1_blockmask is not None:\n+        args.append(stage1_k1_blockmask)\n+    return fn(*args)[0]\n+\n+\n+def main() -> None:\n+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--capture\", default=DEFAULT_CAPTURE)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--device\", default=\"cuda\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--candidate-topk\", type=int, default=1024)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--radius\", type=int, default=8)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--chunk-rows\", type=int, default=64)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--warmup\", type=int, default=1)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--repeat\", type=int, default=3)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--empty-p\", choices=[\"unset\", \"0\", \"1\", \"2\"], default=\"unset\")\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--skip-candidate\", action=\"store_true\")\n+    args = parser.parse_args()\n+\n+    if args.empty_p == \"unset\":\n+        os.environ.pop(\"INFLLM_V2_STAGE1_EMPTY_P\", None)\n+ non_blocking=True).contiguous()\n+\n+    q_len = int(q.shape[0])\n+    max_seqlen_q_adjusted = int(data[\"max_seqlen_q\"]) * group\n+    max_seqlen_k1 = int(data[\"max_seqlen_k1\"])\n+    seqlen_k_rounded = ((max_seqlen_k1 + 127) // 128) * 128\n+    num_tiles = seqlen_k_rounded // 64\n+\n+    all_true_bool = torch.ones((kv_heads, q_len, num_tiles), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)\n+ local_blocks=int(data[\"local_blocks\"]),\n+            ),\n+        }\n+\n+    meta = {\n+        \"capture\": str(capture_path),\n+        \"layer_id\": data.get(\"layer_id\"),\n+        \"q_len\": 目前的结果 工作和结论是什么

> AGENT

目前工作结果：

1. 已实现并编通新 kernel binding：`varlen_fwd_stage1_k1_mask`
   - 旧 `varlen_fwd_stage1` 仍可用。
   - `all-true mask` 和 full stage1 输出完全一致：`max_abs_diff=0`，说明接线正确。
   - mask 只作用在 stage1 第二段 K1 pass，不影响第一段 K2 denominator pass。

2. 真实 capture 离线 kernel bench 结果：
   - L9 full stage1：约 `40.4ms/layer`
   - L9 K2 candidate masked K1：约 `26.0ms/layer`
   - kernel 层 speedup：约 `1.55x`
   - first-pass-only / all-false：约 `8.7ms/layer`，这是理论下界，不是可用输出。

3. 跨层结果，`topk=1024,r=8`：
   - L0：tile recall `98.23%`，tile frac `81.1%`，speedup 只有 `1.17x`
   - L9/L16/L17/L22/L29/L30/L31：tile recall 约 `99.77%-99.96%`，tile frac 约 `52.5%-59.7%`，kernel speedup 约 `1.45x-1.58x`
   - 结论仍是：`L0 exact + L9+ selective K1` 是合理方向。

4. 关键负面结果：
   - 当前 Python/Torch K2 candidate 构造成本约 `290ms/layer`
   - masked K1 kernel 只省约 `14ms/layer`
   - 所以如果直接在线用现在的 Python candidate builder，会明显亏，不应该推。

5. 额外验证：
   - “只用 K1 不做 K2 candidate”的便宜方案 recall 不够。
   - L9 tail 256 rows：global recall 只有 `93.7%`，基本不可接受。

当前结论：kernel 方向成立，但生产收益卡在 candidate 构造成本。下一步最高收益不是马上接在线 Python 路径，而是把 K2 candidate 构造做成低开销 CUDA/Triton 路径，或者把 candidate 生成融合进 stage1 kernel。中短请求现在不能作为可靠收益点，除非 candidate 构造开销先被打下来；否则短中请求更容易被固定开销吞掉。

  "cmd": "python3 - <<'PY'\nimport glob, json, math, torch\nfracs=[0.55,0.65,0.75,0.85]\nfor p in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/prefill_stage1_capture8/*.pt')):\n    d=torch.load(p,map_location='cpu')\n    exact=d['exact_topk_idx'].long()\n    kv,q_len,topk=exact.shape\n    num_tiles=512\n    spt=16\n    block_count=num_tiles*spt\n    cache=int(d['cache_lens'][0]); block_size=int(d['block_size']); init=int(d['init_blocks']); local=int(d['local_blocks'])\n    split=q_len//2\n    rows_train=torch.arange(0,split)\n    rows_eval=torch.arange(split,q_len)\n    def forced(rows):\n        blocks=torch.arange(block_count)\n        qblocks=(rows+cache)//block_size\n        return (blocks.view(1,-1)<init) | ((blocks.view(1,-1)>=torch.clamp(qblocks-local,min=0).view(-1,1)) & (blocks.view(1,-1)<=torch.clamp(qblocks,max=block_count-1).view(-1,1)))\n    exact_train=exact[:,rows_train].clamp(0,block_count-1)//spt\n    exact_eval=exact[:,rows_eval].clamp(0,block_count-1)//spt\n    f_eval=forced(rows_eval)\n    e_valid=(exact[:,rows_eval]>=0)&(exact[:,rows_eval]<block_count)\n    f_at=f_eval.unsqueeze(0).expand(kv,-1,-1).gather(2, exact[:,rows_eval].clamp(0,block_count-1))\n    global_valid=e_valid & ~f_at\n    out={'layer':d['layer_id']}\n    # frequency from train exact global only\n    f_train=forced(rows_train)\n    e_train_valid=(exact[:,rows_train]>=0)&(exact[:,rows_train]<block_count)\n    f_train_at=f_train.unsqueeze(0).expand(kv,-1,-1).gather(2, exact[:,rows_train].clamp(0,block_count-1))\n    train_global=e_train_valid & ~f_train_at\n    for frac in fracs:\n        keep=max(1,int(num_tiles*frac))\n        mask=torch.zeros(kv, rows_eval.numel(), num_tiles, dtype=torch.bool)\n        mask |= f_eval.reshape(rows_eval.numel(),num_tiles,spt).any(-1).unsqueeze(0)\n        for h in range(kv):\n            counts=torch.bincount(exact_train[h][train_global[h]].flatten(), minlength=num_tiles)\n            hot=counts.topk(keep).indices\n            mask[h,:,hot]=True\n        hit=(mask.gather(2, exact_eval)&global_valid).sum().item()\n        total=global_valid.sum().item()\n        full=(((mask.gather(2, exact_eval)&global_valid).sum(-1)==global_valid.sum(-1)) & (global_valid.sum(-1)>0)).sum().item()\n        rows=(global_valid.sum(-1)>0).sum().item()\n        out[f'exacthot_{frac}']={'recall':hit/total,'fullrow':full/rows,'tile_frac':float(mask.float().mean())}\n    print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))\nPY",

line91 单条最长 prefill baseline 结果：

- 输出: `<think>`

结论：当前 online K2 candidate + selective K1 refinement 没有形成有效端到端收益，差异在噪声范围内。它的 kernel 层有局部 savings，但两次 stage1 / 候选构造 / mask 构造开销把收益吃掉了。

两个 subagent 也都结束了，结论一致：  
最高理论收益还是 K2 selective，但必须走 fused/split-stage1，把候选生成并进 stage1 内部，避免额外一次 stage1。短期更稳的高收益候选是 exact fusion：保留 exact 语义，融合 `stage1 -> blockmax/topk`，目标是先拿约 `~1s` line91 级别收益。

- 实现并验证了 K1 mask stage1 路径。

- 修了 skipped tile 必须初始化为 `-inf` 的问题。
- 加了 CUDA fast `K2 indices -> K1 mask` builder。
- 做了 online env-gated prototype，但当前不建议作为提交路径。
- 没跑 public accuracy，按你的约定只测 prefill 单条最长。

> AGENT

目前这轮继续推进完了，结论更清楚：

1. exact `stage1 -> blockmax/topk` 分支已经验证：**结果 exact，但性能不可用**。L9 capture 上旧路径约 `42.6ms`，blockmax fused 约 `188.8ms`，原因是把 pooling 放进 stage1 会破坏原 kernel 的吞吐。记录在 [experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md:468)。

2. 修正了 K2 recall 脚本的多 topk bug，并补了 tile 级指标。真实可用指标应看 tile recall，因为 K1 mask 跳过的是 64-token tile。记录在 [stage1_k2_candidate_recall.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_k2_candidate_recall.py:217) 和 [experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md:537)。

3. 新增了更适合写 kernel 的 tile-score 原型：[stage1_k2_tile_candidate_recall.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_k2_tile_candidate_recall.py:1)。它把 K2 probability evidence 聚合到 512 个 K1 tile，再选 top-M tiles，避免 8192-token 大 topk。

关键结果：

- L0 仍必须 exact。
- L9 是后层最难点。
- L9 top-M `320`: tile recall `99.78%`，masked stage1 `39.36ms -> 28.64ms`。
- L9 top-M `384`: tile recall `99.92%`，masked stage1 `39.36ms -> 32.76ms`。
- 后层 top-M `320` 大约 `99.78-99.97%` tile recall；top-M `384` 大约 `99.88-99.99%`。

当前最高收益实现方向更新为：**单 kernel 内做 K2 probability tile-score top-M candidate，L0 exact，L9+ selective K1**。这比 K2 token topk 更可实现，但如果必须用 top-M `384` 才稳，速度天花板会明显变小。文档已更新在 [roadmap.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/roadmap.md:182)。

验证已跑：两个新/修改脚本都 `py_compile` 通过；当前没有后台 server 或长跑任务。

一个重要收益模型出来了：如果 in-kernel tile-score 需要额外重扫 K2，一层要再花约 first-pass `8.4ms`，top-M320 的尾段净收益会从 `75ms/chunk` 掉到大约 `16ms/chunk`，top-M384 基本不值得。因此下一步不能做“先 denom 再重扫 K2”的复杂原型，必须想办法在第一遍 K2 pass 内维护候选，或者转向别的高收益点。

That would reduce the top-M `320` tail gain\n+  to only about `16ms/chunk` before top-M selection overhead, and would make\n+  top-M `384` unattractive.\n \n Conclusion:\n \n - Tile-score top-M is more implementable than K2-token topk, but the safe setting\n   is wide and has a smaller speed ceiling.\n - The most attractive kernel prototype is likely top-M `320` or `352` for L9+\n   with layer 0 exact, plus an exact-check/fallback mode.\n - If top-M `384` is required for accuracy, the remaining speed headroom may not\n   justify a complex in-stage1 kernel unless the candidate generation is very\n   cheap.\n+- A second K2 scan is probably not cheap enough. The useful implementation would\n+  need to maintain tile evidence during the existing K2 pass, or this branch\n+  should give way to another prefill bottleneck.\n*** End Patch\n"

{
  "cmd": "PYTHONPATH=/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill python3 - <<'PY'\nimport json, math, torch\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom stage1_k2_candidate_recall import forced_block_mask\ncap=Path([REDACTED])\ndata=torch.load(cap,map_location='cpu')\ndevice=torch.device('cuda')\nq_cpu=data['query_layer']; k2_cpu=data['compressed_k2']; exact_cpu=data['exact_topk_idx']\nblock_size=int(data['block_size']); init_blocks=int(data['init_blocks']); local_blocks=int(data['local_blocks']); cache_len=int(data['cache_lens'][0]); actual_k2_len=int(data['cu_seqlens_k2'][-1])\nq_len=q_cpu.shape[0]; kv_heads=k2_cpu.shape[1]; q_heads=q_cpu.shape[1]; group=q_heads//kv_heads; d=q_cpu.shape[-1]\nnum_tiles=((int(data['max_seqlen_k1'])+127)//128*128)//64; block_count=num_tiles*16; radius=8; topms=[320,352,384]\n# modes: prob_sum uses softmax/group denom. exp_sum uses exp(logit-rowmax) without rowsum. raw_max uses raw logits max over groups/tokens.\nstats={(mode,M):{'hit':0,'total':0,'full':0,'rows':0} for mode in ['prob_sum','exp_sum','raw_max'] for M in topms}\nkt=k2_cpu[:actual_k2_len].to(device=device,dtype=torch.bfloat16).permute(1,2,0).contiguous(); k2_ids=torch.arange(actual_k2_len,device=device)\nfor start in range(0,q_len,128):\n    end=min(q_len,start+128); rows=torch.arange(start,end,dtype=torch.int64); rc=end-start\n    q=q_cpu[start:end].to(device=device,dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    qg=q.reshape(rc,kv_heads,group,d).permute(1,2,0,3).contiguous()\n    logits=torch.matmul(qg,kt.unsqueeze(1)).mul_(d**-0.5).float()\n    forced_rows=forced_block_mask(q_indices=rows,cache_len=cache_len,block_count=block_count,block_size=block_size,init_blocks=init_blocks,local_blocks=local_blocks,device=device)\n    q_blocks=(rows.to(device=device)+cache_len)//block_size\n    valid=k2_ids.view(1,1,1,-1)<=q_blocks.view(1,1,rc,1)\n    valid &= ~forced_rows[:,:actual_k2_len].view(1,1,rc,actual_k2_len)\n    logits.masked_fill_(~valid,float('-inf'))\n    row_max=logits.amax(dim=-1,keepdim=True)\n    exp=torch.exp(logits-row_max).masked_fill(~torch.isfinite(logits),0.0)\n    probs=torch.softmax(logits,dim=-1)\n    scores={\n      'prob_sum': probs.sum(dim=1),\n      'exp_sum': exp.sum(dim=1),\n      'raw_max': logits.amax(dim=1),\n    }\n    forced=forced_rows.unsqueeze(0).expand(kv_heads,-1,-1)\n    forced_tiles=forced.reshape(kv_heads,rc,num_tiles,16).any(dim=-1)\n    exact=exact_cpu[:,start:end].to(device=device,dtype=torch.int64); exact_safe=exact.clamp(0,block_count-1); exact_valid=(exact>=0)&(exact<block_count); forced_at=forced.gather(2,exact_safe); exact_global=exact_valid & ~forced_at; exact_tiles=exact_safe//16; total=exact_global.sum(dim=2); valid_rows=total>0\n    for mode,score in scores.items():\n      tile_score=torch.full((kv_heads,rc,num_tiles),float('-inf'),device=device)\n      for delta in range(-radius,radius+2):\n        sb=(k2_ids+delta).clamp(0,block_count-1); ok=(k2_ids+delta>=0)&(k2_ids+delta<block_count); tile=(sb//16).to(torch.int64)\n        tile_score.scatter_reduce_(2,tile.view(1,1,-1).expand(kv_heads,rc,-1),score.masked_fill(~ok.view(1,1,-1),float('-inf')),reduce='amax',include_self=True)\n      tile_score.masked_fill_(forced_tiles,float('inf'))\n      for M in topms:\n        idx=tile_score.topk(M,dim=-1,sorted=False).indices; cand=torch.zeros_like(tile_score,dtype=torch.bool); cand.scatter_(2,idx,True)\n        hit=(cand.gather(2,exact_tiles)&exact_global).sum(dim=2); st=stats[(mode,M)]\n        st['hit']+=int(hit.sum()); st['total']+=int(total.sum()); st['full']+=int(((hit==total)&valid_rows).sum()); st['rows']+=int(valid_rows.sum())\n    torch.cuda.empty_cache()\nprint(json.dumps({'capture':str(cap),'layer_id':data.get('layer_id'),'radius':radius},sort_keys=True))\nfor mode in ['prob_sum','exp_sum','raw_max']:\n  for M in topms:\n    st=stats[(mode,M)]\n    print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'top_m_tiles':M,'tile_global_recall':st['hit']/st['total'],'tile_full_row_rate':st['full']/st['rows']},sort_keys=True))\nPY",

  "yield_time_ms": 1000,
  "max_output_tokens": 30000
}

进度汇报：

我沿 exact fusion 做了实现和验证：把 stage1 blockmax 分支从 atomic pooling 改成 shared 64-score tile + 17 lane 窗口 max，代码在 [flash_fwd_kernel.h](/user_4813494d/openbmb/kernels/infllmv2_cuda_impl/csrc/flash_attn/src/flash_fwd_kernel.h:127)。已重编 InfLLM-v2，最终 `.so` md5 是 `9c255e9ecfb4efa3a9eeab6c321d5a0e`。

L9 tail capture 结果：

| 路径 | 时间 |
|---|---:|
| 旧 `stage1 + pool + topk` | `43.37ms` |
| 新 shared-score blockmax + topk | `52.89ms` |

正确性没问题：`block_equal=True`，`bad_vs_capture=0`。但速度仍然慢约 `9.5ms/layer`，所以结论明确：当前 exact blockmax-in-stage1 不值得继续作为提速路径，只保留 default-off 当 correctness oracle。

文档已更新：
- [prefill/experiment-log.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/experiment-log.md:537)
- [prefill/roadmap.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/roadmap.md:114)

当前没有未结束的实验进程。下一步应回到 K2 selective fused/split-stage1：候选生成必须并进现有 K2 first pass；如果额外做第二次 K2 scan，收益基本会被吃掉。

torch.cuda.synchronize()\n+    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters\n+\n+\n+def main() -> None:\n+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--m\", type=int, default=8192)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--inter\", type=int, default=16384)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--warmup\", type=int, default=10)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--iters\", type=int, default=50)\n+    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=0)\n+    args = parser.parse_args()\n+\n+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)\n+    device = torch.device(\"cuda\")\n+    dtype = torch.bfloat16\n+    m = args.m\n+    inter = args.inter\n+\n+    gate_up = torch.randn((m, inter * 2), device=device, dtype=dtype) * 0.02\n+    input_scale_inv = torch.ones((1,), device=device, dtype=torch.float32)\n+    mask = torch.tensor([m], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)\n+    act = torch.empty((m, inter), device=device, dtype=dtype)\n+\n+    def separate_swiglu():\n+        silu_and_mul(gate_up, act)\n+        return act\n+\n+    def separate_swiglu_quant():\n+        silu_and_mul(gate_up, act)\n+        return scaled_fp4_quant(act, input_scale_inv)\n+\n+    def fused_swiglu_quant():\n+        return silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant(\n+            gate_up.view(1, m, inter * 2),\n+            input_scale_inv,\n+            mask,\n+        )\n+\n+    # Smoke once before timing and validate output layout.\n+    sep_q, sep_sf = separate_swiglu_quant()\n+    fused_q, fused_sf = fused_swiglu_quant()\n+    fused_q_2d = fused_q[:, :, 0]\n+    fused_sf_5d = fused_sf[..., 0]\n+\n+    print(f\"device={torch.cuda.get_device_name(device)}\")\n+    print(f\"shape m={m} inter={inter} dtype={dtype}\")\n+    print(\n+        \"layout \"\n+        f\"separate_q={tuple(sep_q.shape)} f\"fused_q_2d={tuple(fused_q_2d.shape)} fused_sf_5d={tuple(fused_sf_5d.shape)}\"\n+    )\n+    print(\n+        \"byte_diff \"\n+        f\"q={int((sep_q != fused_q_2d).sum().item())} \"\n+ print(f\"separate_swiglu_quant_ms={t_separate:.4f}\")\n+    print(f\"fused_swiglu_quant_ms={t_fused:.4f}\")\n+    print(f\"fused_speedup={t_separate / t_fused:.3f}x\")\n+    print(f\"saved_ms_per_layer={t_separate - t_fused:.4f}\")\n+    print(f\"saved_ms_32_layers={(t_separate - t_fused) * 32:.2f}\")\n+\n+\n+if __name__ == \"__main__\":\n+    main()\n*** End Patch\n"

> AGENT

目前没有残留 benchmark/server 进程。

当前工作主线：

1. `stage1 -> blockmax/topk` exact fusion 已经实现并验证 exact 正确，但性能是负的。
   - old `stage1 + pool + topk`: `43.37ms/layer`
   - fused blockmax + topk: `52.89ms/layer`
   - 结论：保留为 default-off 研究代码，不作为提速方案。

2. 重新审了 MLP prefill 路径，发现一个积极点：生产模型 `pre_quant_scale=false`，所以现有 `MiniCPMMLP` 默认能走 `silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant` fused 路径。
   - 我新加了 microbench: `bench/infllmv2/bench_mlp_fused_act_quant.py`
   - `M=8192` 复测结果：
     - separate `silu+quant`: `0.8910ms/layer`
     - fused `silu+quant`: `0.4962ms/layer`
     - 节省 `0.3948ms/layer`，32 层约 `12.63ms/chunk`
   - `M=2754`：
     - 节省约 `6.46ms/32 layers`

3. FlashInfer dense-as-MoE 整段替代不是短期候选。
   - 两个 shape 的 first fused call 超过 45 秒没返回，我已终止。
   - 结论：不适合现在打主测 prefill 快速收益。

积极结果是：我们把 exact fusion 这条看似高收益但实际负收益的路排除了，并确认 MLP 当前已经吃到一块真实 fusion 收益。下一步最高收益仍回到 `K2 selective`，但必须做进原 stage1 内部；MLP 侧短期只剩更难的 `gate_up GEMM epilogue + SwiGLU + FP4 quant`，不是简单 Python/backend patch。

做完了 e2e A/B，结果是正的。

测试口径：line91 单条最长 accepted prefill，`prompt_tokens=524183`，`max_tokens=1`，无 spec，`mem_fraction_static=0.75`，`max_running_requests=36`，`chunked_prefill_size=8192`，只切：

- ON: `SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_MLP_ACT_QUANT=1`
- OFF: `SGLANG_MINICPM_FUSED_MLP_ACT_QUANT=0`

结果：

| 配置 | 4 次 latency | steady avg 2-4 |
|---|---:|---:|
| fused ON | `35.251s`, `34.802s`, `34.825s`, `34.828s` | `34.818s` |
| fused OFF | `35.655s`, `35.264s`, `35.311s`, `35.277s` | `35.284s` |

结论：

- e2e steady 收益：`0.465s`，约 `1.32%` line91 wall-time。
- 首轮收益约 `0.403s`。
- 输出一致，都是 `<think>`。
- 这是实打实收益，应该保持默认开启。
- 但它已经是当前生产默认可走路径，因为目标模型 `pre_quant_scale=false`，所以这不是新的可打开收益，而是确认“不能关掉”。

{
  "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: /user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_k2_tile_candidate_recall.py\n@@\n         \"prob_groupmax_sum\",\n         \"exp_groupmax_sum\",\n+        \"online_prob_groupmax_sum\",\n@@\n             evidence in stats\n-            for evidence in (\"prob_sum\", \"prob_tile_sum\", \"prob_groupmax_sum\")\n+            for evidence in (\n+                \"prob_sum\",\n+                \"prob_tile_sum\",\n+                \"prob_groupmax_sum\",\n+                \"online_prob_groupmax_sum\",\n+            )\n@@\n             if \"prob_groupmax_sum\" in stats:\n                 group_tile_score = torch.full(\n                     (kv_heads, group, row_count, num_tiles),\n@@\n                     )\n                 tile_scores_by_mode[\"prob_groupmax_sum\"] = group_tile_score.sum(dim=1)\n+            if \"online_prob_groupmax_sum\" in stats:\n+                row_max = torch.full(\n+                    (kv_heads, group, row_count, 1),\n+                    float(\"-inf\"),\n+                    dtype=torch.float32,\n+                    device=device,\n+                )\n+                row_sum = torch.zeros_like(row_max)\n+                group_tile_score = torch.full(\n+                    (kv_heads, group, row_count, num_tiles),\n+                    float(\"-inf\"),\n+                    dtype=torch.float32,\n+                    device=device,\n+                )\n+                for block_start in range(0, actual_k2_len, args.online_block):\n+                    block_end = min(actual_k2_len, block_start + args.online_block)\n+                    block = logits[..., block_start:block_end]\n+                    block_max = block.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)\n+                    new_max = torch.maximum(row_max, block_max)\n+                    prev_scale = torch.where(\n+                        torch.isfinite(row_max) & torch.isfinite(new_max),\n+                        torch.exp(row_max - new_max),\n+                        torch.zeros_like(new_max),\n+                    )\n+                    cur = torch.where(\n+                        torch.isfinite(block),\n+                        torch.exp(block - new_max),\n+                        torch.zeros_like(block),\n+                    )\n+                    row_sum = row_sum * prev_scale + cur.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)\n+                    group_tile_score = group_tile_score * prev_scale\n+                    for tile_idx, valid_delta in zip(tile_indices_by_delta, valid_by_delta):\n+                        tile_idx_block = tile_idx[..., block_start:block_end]\n+                        valid_block = valid_delta[..., block_start:block_end]\n+                        expanded = cur.masked_fill(~valid_block.unsqueeze(1), float(\"-inf\"))\n+                        group_tile_score.scatter_reduce_(\n+                            3,\n+                            tile_idx_block.unsqueeze(1).expand(kv_heads, group, row_count, -1),\n+                            expanded,\n+                            reduce=\"amax\",\n+                            include_self=True,\n+                        )\n+                    row_max = new_max\n+                normalized = torch.where(\n+                    row_sum > 0,\n+                    group_tile_score / row_sum,\n+                    torch.zeros_like(group_tile_score),\n+                )\n+                tile_scores_by_mode[\"online_prob_groupmax_sum\"] = normalized.sum(dim=1)\n@@\n         help=(\n             \"Comma-separated evidence modes: prob_sum, exp_sum, raw_max, \"\n-            \"prob_tile_sum, exp_tile_sum, prob_groupmax_sum, exp_groupmax_sum.\"\n+            \"prob_tile_sum, exp_tile_sum, prob_groupmax_sum, exp_groupmax_sum, \"\n+            \"online_prob_groupmax_sum.\"\n         ),\n     )\n+    parser.add_argument(\n+        \"--online-block\",\n+        type=int,\n+        default=64,\n+        help=\"K2 block size for online_* evidence simulations.\",\n+    )\n*** End Patch\n"

更大的进展在 K2 selective：

- 新增/扩展了 [stage1_k2_tile_candidate_recall.py](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1_k2_tile_candidate_recall.py:68)
- 找到当前最好候选：`prob_groupmax_sum`
- 排除 L0 后：
  - top-M320: mean/min recall `99.915% / 99.785%`
  - top-M352: `99.956% / 99.870%`
  - top-M384: `99.978% / 99.915%`
- `online_prob_groupmax_sum` 用 K2 block=64 流式模拟，和离线 `prob_groupmax_sum` 全 8 层完全一致：`0` mismatch
- 这说明它不是离线假象，可以在 K2 first pass 里用 online softmax rescale 生成，不需要第二次 K2 scan

还有一个实现层面的好消息：`_adjust_stage1_q` 会把 `(total_q,32,128)` 变成 `(total_q*16,2,128)`，而 stage1 kernel 是 `kBlockM=16,kBlockN=64`，刚好一个 CTA row block 覆盖一个 token 的 16 个 query-head group。这和 `prob_groupmax_sum` 的归约形态对齐。

同时我也否掉了一个低收益备选：`prob_tile_sum` 需要 top-M416 才接近 recall，但 7 个非 L0 层尾段只剩约 `34.3ms/chunk` 理论收益，不值得优先写 kernel。

  - top-M384 `99.978% / 99.916%`
  - 相比 fp32 online，每层 hit diff 只有 `[-2, +6]` 量级

这让 CUDA 方案更现实：现有 stage1 smem 约 `36KB/CTA`，fp32 tile max 要额外 `32KB`，总 `68KB`；bf16 tile max 只要额外 `16KB`，总约 `52KB/CTA`，更适合先做 kernel prototype。

我写了实现设计文档：[stage1-groupmax-design.md](/user_4813494d/openbmb/prefill/stage1-groupmax-design.md:52)。当前首选路线是 one-kernel fused stage1：

1. K2 first pass 内维护 bf16 per-group tile max
2. row max/sum 仍用 fp32
3. row sum finalize 后归一化并 sum 16 group rows
4. 本 CTA 内 top-M 生成 local 512-bit mask
5. 第二段 K1 pass 直接走 local mask，避免第二次 K2 scan
